name: Drought
value: E Africa, S Africa, Australia wheat hit
summary: El Niño drought threatens East and southern Africa; no major exporter's harvest has failed
state: FEWS NET's October special report warns that El Niño-driven drought in East and southern Africa will deepen food insecurity, with the worst impacts expected into 2027 (FEWS NET). Dryness persists in southern Africa ahead of planting. No harvest failure in a major exporter had been confirmed as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Food importers and farming regions in southern and East Africa are most exposed in the coming season.
rubric_hit: Severe drought in major crop regions = Watch

sources.title: FEWS NET — 2026–2027 El Niño food security impacts

why: Drought slowly destroys harvests, hydropower and river shipping, and drives famine and migration.
drivers: Rainfall deficits, heat, ENSO, groundwater depletion.

rubric.alert: Drought driving famine conditions, a major exporter's harvest failure, or monsoon failure across a major breadbasket.
rubric.watch: Severe drought in a major crop region, a major river at record low, or a monsoon running more than 20% below normal.
rubric.normal: No major breadbasket in severe drought.
